privileged_info_for_vlm: The dataset contains a contaminated participant 'sub-99' who must be excluded for having ~100% accuracy at 1 dot but 0% accuracy for >1 dot with fast reaction times. The final report must be a JSON file located at /home/ga/pebl/analysis/subitizing_report.json. The subitizing slope is calculated on 1-3 dots and the counting slope on 5-8 dots using only correct trials.
